findings.title: A searcher who lands on a /cycles/<slug> page by the theorist's name cannot find where the cycle puts this year without reading it off the extrema row
findings.suggested: Prepare to evaluate: "W-003's cold walk (2026-10-03) opens /cycles/dalio at 390 wide and records whether the reader finds 'where are we now' and how far they scrolled to find it; and the W-001 Search Console read (2026-10-07) reports /cycles/dalio's position on the Dalio queries against 49.5-60. A walk that finds the sentence but only after scrolling is a finding about placement (move it up only if a fold can pay for it), not a reason to reopen the wording."
